name: PWM and switching controller ICs
summary: Controller chips that run switch-mode power supplies, inverters and motor speed controls.
uses: Building a DC-DC converter or inverter
Motor speed and LED dimming controllers
identify: 8 or 16-pin chips near the switching transistors and ferrite transformer of a power supply: UC3842/3843/3845, TL494, SG3525, IR2153. The TL494 is in nearly every older PC power supply.
test: Best tested in circuit with an oscilloscope. Without one, look for a cracked or burnt chip and check the voltage on its supply pin.
